𝗦𝗘𝗛𝗪𝗔𝗚'𝗦 𝗦𝗢𝗡 𝗦𝗠𝗔𝗦𝗛𝗘𝗦 𝟭𝟲𝟬! 🔥🇮🇳

Aaryavir Sehwag hit 160 off 168 balls (17 fours, 7 sixes) for India U19 v UAE in the U19 Asia Cup.
India 309/7; he added 193 with VK Vineeth.

Future star? 👇
